sentences.text:
THE TAHSILDAR, GADIVEMULA MANDAL, GADIVEMULA,
 NANDYALA DISTRICT, ANDHRA PRADESH  ...RESPONDENT(S):
 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased topleased to pass an order or direction or Writ,
more specifically one in the nature of a writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondent revenue authorities in not paying compensation of Rs 5.50 lakhs per acre as was paid to patta holders for the same acquisition and instead paying only Rs 4.20 lakhs per acre in respect of the petitioner's land of Ac 3.56 cents in survey no.
842/C and Ac 1.00 cents in Survey No. 842/D2 in Gani Village of Gadivemula Mandal, Nandyal District, Andhra pradesh In respect of the land holding of the petitioners resumed by the respondents as illegal, contrary to the settled law laid down by the honourable High 'Court of Andhra Pradesh in .Mekala Pandu. case and and as confirmed by the Honourable Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No 7904- 7912 dated 04-08-2014 and consequently direct payment of the balance Rs.1.3 lakhs Per acre in respect of the land holding of the petitioner in respect of his land holding with all applicable consequential benefits including interest from the date of taking possession on 03-03-2015 and pass  2 S Nagamma vs The State Of Ap on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130080473/
1 IA NO: 1 OF 2023  Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased pleased to direct that the above writ petition to be taken up out of turn and directed to be posted for final hearing as the petitioner's lands were taken away from her as far back as in the year 2015 and pass Counsel for the Petitioner:
 1. A SRINATH Counsel for the Respondent(S):
 1. GP FOR LAND ACQUISITION The Court made the following:
 3 THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO  WRIT PETITION No.30769 of 2023 ORDER:
Learned counsel for petitioner appeared virtually and submitted that in view of amendment issued vide G.O.Ms.No.23, Revenue (Lands.I), dated 19.01.2024, the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023, this writ petition has been rendered infructuous.
